name: Certificate of Direct Investment

requirements.blocker_text: Reported requirement of an investment of at least US$1,000,000 in an employment-generating business; not independently confirmed against the governing regulation's text in this pass.
requirements.fix_path: Make a qualifying investment of at least US$1,000,000 in an employment-generating business in the Cayman Islands.

requirements.blocker_text: Reported requirement of a minimum of 90 days in aggregate physical presence in the Cayman Islands each calendar year.

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: minimum 90 days in aggregate per calendar year

sources.title: Cayman Islands Immigration (Transition) Act (2022 Revision) -- Sections 47-48: confirms the Certificate of Direct Investment exists, with revocation grounds under Section 48, but does not itself state the investment threshold in the text extracted
Ogier (offshore law firm) -- Securing Cayman Residency via Independent Means or Direct Investment: reported US$1,000,000 investment threshold, 90-day physical presence requirement, and fee schedule

notes: STATUS: DRAFT, part of the Cayman Islands' initial build, for the same reason as ky_persons_independent_means.json: the Act confirms this certificate exists (Sections 47-48) but the specific investment threshold lives in subsidiary regulation not reached at tier-1 in this pass; the figure here is Ogier's reporting, a reputable but non-government tier-3 source. work_rights is 'restricted' rather than 'none' (unlike the Persons of Independent Means certificate) since this route is explicitly premised on running or holding an employment-generating business, which plausibly implies some occupational activity by the holder, though this is inferred rather than explicitly stated as a work-rights rule in the source.
